project.name: qsot-harness-verification
project.canonical_statement: Reference run and claim-governance record for QSOT-Harness v2.1.1, the honest reconstruction of the v1.2.3 slop artifact (toe-test-0057): a bounded, epistemically-labeled phenomenological verification harness, verified for model-output consistency only.

design_invariants.label: machine-readable-claim-boundary
design_invariants.statement: Every result must serialize a fixed claim boundary (no external physical validity, no new-law claim, model-output consistency only) and an evidence class for every major observation.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058: Stage A made claim_boundary, the 7-class evidence taxonomy, audit/runtime backend surfacing, calibration manifest, and synthetic-vs-model separation machine-readable.

design_invariants.label: advisory-metric-positioning
design_invariants.statement: All computed values are strictly advisory heuristics under a phenomenological channel-map ansatz. Gate and verdict labels are policy-derived classifications, not physical observables. No external physical claims or quantum-gravity derivations are made.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058: Honest reconstruction of the v1.2.3 slop artifact; provenance locked to ADVISORY.

design_invariants.label: negative-results-surfaced
design_invariants.statement: Non-failure degradations must be surfaced, not hidden: KD optimizer non-convergence -> DEGRADED_PASS; the model trajectory is Markovian by construction (nm=0); the optional governance backend may be absent (SKIPPED).

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058: DEGRADED_PASS verdict reported in the abstract and result artifact with both documented causes.

design_invariants.label: no-hidden-hardcoding-or-stubbed-core-results
design_invariants.statement: Core mathematical results must be config-driven, named-constant-driven, or directly derived from executed state/channel evolution. Any value governing a headline result must surface its provenance in the source artifact and be re-checkable by the ledger; unlabeled stubs and hidden local hardcodings are disallowed.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058 refresh: Phase 4 state-preparation depth moved under config.steps; Phase 5 memory-proxy channel sensitivity moved under config.sensitivity.

operation_meta.bootstrap_note: MICA package created for toe-test-0059; refreshed after v2.1.1 for config-driven Phase 4/5, then revision r1 (committed source c0f6c6a) for the R0-R2 source/schema hardening (KD best-objective reporting, deprecated-field removal, threshold/policy/toy-curvature/coverage provenance).
